epics.title: Resolve Datastore Runtime Contract Discrepancy
epics.jtbd: When relying on the system, I want the datastore to behave exactly as tested, so that data operations do not fail unexpectedly in production.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce escaped datastore-specific defects in production from X to 0.
requirements: R1: Extend adr-002-runtime-contract.md to explicitly declare the single datastore for the product.
R2: Align application.properties, docker-compose.yml, and pom.xml to match the datastore declared in the contract.

slices.title: Unify datastore configuration across runtime artifacts
slices.jtbd: When implementing the datastore alignment for this epic, I want to update the ADR and sync the configuration artifacts to it, so that the environment inconsistency is resolved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given adr-002-runtime-contract.md declares the datastore
When inspecting application.properties, docker-compose.yml, and pom.xml
Then they all declare the same datastore engine and appropriate driver
Given the application runs in test or docker
When a database query is executed
Then it runs against the correctly matching datastore without engine mismatch errors
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% alignment between runtime artifacts and ADR datastore declaration.
